description: This file defines the implementation of the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, handling JSON-RPC response message parsing and validation.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response ID, validate response, and retrieve result or error objects.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Constructor for the Response class, initializes the object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the JSON-RPC response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response if present.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the JSON-RPC response based on its fields and version.
